title: Petal Panic Menu Hub
why: The current flow jumps from Home to Select and lacks real menu options, persistent progress, level selection, boss rush, media unlocks, and pause save/settings.
outcomes: Add a main menu with New Game, Continue, Level Select, Boss Rush, Media, Controls, Options, Credits; add shared pause options and Save & Quit; persist progress/settings; reuse existing screen ergonomics for buttons, focus, and navigation.

milestones.name: Progress and Settings Persistence
milestones.objective: Create one persistent local storage layer for game progress, settings, media unlocks, and save metadata.
milestones.success: The game can load/save a single JSON blob in localStorage with safe defaults and explicit APIs for progress and settings.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[localStorage] --> B[progressStore]
  B --> C[progress]
  B --> D[settings]
  B --> E[mediaUnlocks]
  B --> F[saveMeta]
  C --> G[Level Select]
  C --> H[Boss Rush]
  D --> I[Options]
  E --> J[Media Menu]

tasks.name: Persistent progress and settings store
tasks.what: Add a localStorage-backed store for Petal Panic progress, settings, media unlocks, and save metadata.
tasks.why: Menus need persistent Continue, Level Select, Boss Rush, Media, and Options state without scattering localStorage calls through screens.
acceptance: loadStore returns defaults when localStorage is empty or invalid
saveStore persists one JSON document under a stable key
updateProgress and updateSettings mutate and persist atomically
hasSave reflects whether a resumable run exists

milestones.name: Main Menu Hub
milestones.objective: Replace the current Home-to-Select jump with a real main menu hub that routes into gameplay, selection, options, and meta screens.
milestones.success: The player can choose New Game, Continue, Level Select, Boss Rush, Media, Controls, Options, and Credits using the same focus pill and keycap nav style as Pause.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[HOME] --> B[Main Menu]
  B --> C[New Game]
  B --> D[Continue]
  B --> E[Level Select]
  B --> F[Boss Rush]
  B --> G[Media]
  B --> H[Controls]
  B --> I[Options]
  B --> J[Credits]
  C --> K[SELECT]
  D --> L[PLAY]
  E --> M[Level Select Screen]
  F --> N[Boss Rush Screen]
  G --> O[Media Screen]
  H --> P[REMAP]
  I --> Q[Options Screen]

tasks.name: Main menu state and routing
tasks.what: Add MENU states for the main hub, options, level select, boss rush, and media screens, plus transition rules from HOME, PAUSE, and submenus.
tasks.why: The existing state machine only supports HOME, SELECT, PLAY, PAUSE, OVER, WIN, REMAP, AREA_ENTRY, REWARD, and END_OF_GAME, so new menu destinations need explicit states.
acceptance: HOME can transition to MENU
MENU can transition to every top-level destination
PAUSE can open OPTIONS and return to MENU or PLAY
LEVEL_SELECT and BOSS_RUSH can start play through AREA_ENTRY

tasks.name: Main menu screen
tasks.what: Add a canvas-drawn MENU screen with the same centered option list, focus pill, and nav bar style as Pause.
tasks.why: The user wants a real entry point that feels like the existing menus instead of an extra HTML overlay.
acceptance: Menu draws all top-level options using the pause-style focus pill
Continue is disabled when no save exists
up/down moves focus and confirm routes to the selected destination
back from MENU returns HOME

tasks.name: New Game and Continue flow
tasks.what: Wire MENU New Game and Continue to the existing hero select/play lifecycle and persist a resumable save.
tasks.why: The menu is only useful if it can start a fresh run or resume the last saved level/area safely.
acceptance: New Game clears the active run save but preserves meta unlocks
Continue starts the saved level/area through AREA_ENTRY
Save & Quit writes saveMeta before returning to MENU
disabled Continue cannot be selected or confirmed

milestones.name: Level Select and Boss Rush
milestones.objective: Add Level Select and Boss Rush screens that show locked/unlocked content with hover-style tooltips on the right side.
milestones.success: Level Select shows 8 zones × 5 stages, Boss Rush shows boss cards, and locked items explain what must be passed before unlocking.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[LEVEL_SELECT] --> B[Zone Grid]
  B --> C[Stage Cards]
  C --> D[Locked Card]
  C --> E[Unlocked Card]
  C --> F[Completed Card]
  G[BOSS_RUSH] --> H[Boss Cards]
  H --> I[Locked Boss]
  H --> J[Unlocked Boss]
  D --> K[Right Side Tooltip]
  I --> K
  J --> L[Boss Name Tooltip]

tasks.name: Level select model
tasks.what: Add a pure model that turns LEVEL_CONFIGS and progress into 8 selectable levels plus 5 sub-area choices per selected level.
tasks.why: Level Select needs stable data for the world map markers, sub-area chips under the selected level, locking, completion, and starting the correct level/zone.
acceptance: buildLevelMap returns exactly 8 level markers and never includes zone nodes in the map data
buildSubAreasForLevel returns exactly 5 sub-areas: X-1, X-2, X-3, X-4, X-B for the selected level
a sub-area is locked when its previous sub-area is not completed
the first sub-area of level 1 is unlocked by default

tasks.name: Level select screen
tasks.what: Add the LEVEL_SELECT canvas screen using the existing menu card/focus style and a right-side tooltip panel.
tasks.why: The user specifically wants 8 columns, 5 rows, lock icons, and hover-style text explaining what unlocks each card.
acceptance: draws 8 columns and 5 rows without overflow at 960x540
locked cards show a lock icon and dimmed content
focused locked card shows 'Pass <previous stage> to unlock' on the right
confirm starts an unlocked stage through AREA_ENTRY

tasks.name: Boss rush model and screen
tasks.what: Add Boss Rush data and a canvas screen showing boss cards with locked silhouettes and right-side unlock/name tooltips.
tasks.why: Boss Rush should hide locked bosses completely while revealing the boss card image and name only after the required level is passed.
acceptance: returns one card per LEVEL_CONFIGS entry
locked boss cards show no boss image, only a lock icon
focused locked boss shows 'Pass Level X to unlock this boss' on the right
focused unlocked boss shows the boss name and boss card image
confirm starts an unlocked boss through AREA_ENTRY

milestones.name: Options, Controls, and Pause Integration
milestones.objective: Make Controls and Options reusable from both Main Menu and Pause, and add Save & Quit to Pause.
milestones.success: Pause has Resume, Retry Level, Save & Quit, Controls, and Options; Options persists music/SFX/screen shake; Controls still opens the existing remap screen.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[PAUSE] --> B[Resume]
  A --> C[Retry Level]
  A --> D[Save and Quit]
  A --> E[Controls]
  A --> F[Options]
  G[MENU] --> E
  G --> F
  E --> H[REMAP]
  F --> I[OPTIONS]
  I --> J[progressStore.settings]

tasks.name: Options screen and settings wiring
tasks.what: Add an OPTIONS screen with Music, SFX, and Screen Shake toggles that persist through progressStore.
tasks.why: The user wants Options in both menu and pause, and the game currently has no persistent options system.
acceptance: OPTIONS draws three toggle rows using the same focus style as Pause
left/right toggles the focused option
changes persist immediately to localStorage
back returns to MENU or PAUSE based on origin

tasks.name: Pause menu Save and Quit integration
tasks.what: Update Pause to include Save & Quit, Options, and Controls while preserving Resume and Retry behavior.
tasks.why: The user explicitly wants pause to have save and quit plus options accessible during gameplay.
acceptance: Pause shows five options in the existing centered list style
Save & Quit writes progress/saveMeta and returns to MENU
Controls opens REMAP with parent PAUSE
Options opens OPTIONS with origin PAUSE

milestones.name: Media Menu and Unlock Rewards
milestones.objective: Add a Media screen for intro, level clips, and ending content with locked/unlocked presentation.
milestones.success: Media shows locked cards until the related intro/level/ending milestone is completed, then allows playback of sprite-loop or video placeholders.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[MENU] --> B[MEDIA]
  B --> C[Intro Card]
  B --> D[Level Clip Cards]
  B --> E[Ending Card]
  F[progress.mediaUnlocked] --> C
  F --> D
  F --> E
  C --> G[Locked or Playable]
  D --> G
  E --> G
  G --> H[Playback Overlay]

tasks.name: Media unlock model
tasks.what: Add a media catalog and unlock rules for intro, per-level clips, and ending.
tasks.why: The Media screen needs one source of truth for what exists, what is locked, and what unlocks it.
acceptance: returns intro, eight level clips, and ending
intro unlocks after any New Game start
level clip unlocks after the matching boss is defeated
ending unlocks after the final boss is defeated

tasks.name: Media screen and playback overlay
tasks.what: Add the MEDIA canvas screen with locked cards, right-side tooltips, and a simple playback overlay for unlocked clips.
tasks.why: The user wants media to be part of the menu and to remain locked until the intro/level/ending content is earned.
acceptance: MEDIA draws all media cards using the same card/focus style as Level Select
locked media shows no preview image and an unlock requirement on the right
unlocked media can open a playback overlay
back closes playback first, then returns to MENU

tasks.name: Progress unlock hooks
tasks.what: Hook gameplay milestones into progressStore so level completion, boss defeat, and ending completion unlock Level Select, Boss Rush, and Media.
tasks.why: The menu screens need real unlock state instead of always showing everything as available.
acceptance: completing a normal stage records completedAreas
defeating a boss records defeatedBosses
defeating a boss unlocks the matching media clip
defeating the final boss unlocks the ending media card
